Both can take minutes, so both run off the GUI thread: :class:`PackageInstall` runs ``pip`` as a child process watched from the event loop, and :class:`CheckpointDownload` runs the zoo's download on a worker thread. Each reports progress while it runs and a single result when it ends, and a failure is a message rather than an exception, so a failed install leaves the screen that started it working.
